title: Arkret Agent Signer Evidence Operations
description: Server-to-server controller Account Authority gate issuance used by Agent signer evidence verification.

principal_id.description: Controller principal whose Account Authority lifecycle gate is being attested.

agent_authority_id.description: Agent PCR authority service assembling signer evidence. It MUST equal both the authenticated S2S caller and service_id in the controller principal's current AcceptedAtServiceBinding.

agent_authority_resolution.description: Current signed route and method-native control evidence for the Agent PCR authority. The Account Authority verifies this carrier before using its RFC 9421 keyid; a did_core_id, URL, bearer token or self-asserted public key is never a key source.

controller_account_gate_attestation_issu.description: Closed S2S request for the Account Authority-owned controller lifecycle gate. Agent state, account_id and raw account cell material are deliberately absent.
Byte-stable issuance outcome. The embedded attestation is the only Account Authority material admitted into AgentSignerEvidence.
